Title: Weigh the Heart with multiple (D) targets

Messages.Author: Miasmat
Messages.Body:
> Weigh the Heart
> Action Modifier
> Only usable as a  action is announced. If this action is successful, put a corruption counter on a minion controlled by the target Methuselah (after resolving the action).
>
If I take an action that has multiple methuselahs targetted by the , who can I put corruption counters on?

a) Can't play the card since it says "the target Methuselah".
b) Put 1 corruption counter on 1 minion controlled by any 1 of the methuselahs.
c) Put 1 corruption counter on a minion controlled by EACH of the methuselahs.

On a "totally unrelated" note, is Vaticination  targeted at me too?

> Vaticination
> Action
> +3 stealth action.
> Look at each Methuselah's hand and select one card from among all those hands to discard (it may be one from your own hand).
>

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body:
For the first question, I agree with the posts above.

For the second one, IIRC actions cannot be targeted at yourself ; if you are the only target it became undirected instead.

So, Vaticination is targeted at every other methuselah.
